description_en: Unbinds tags from a list of Instant resources in a unified manner. After a tag is unbound, if it is not bound to any other resources, the tag is automatically deleted
description_zh: 为Instant资源列表统一解绑标签。解绑后，如果该标签没有绑定其他任何资源，会被自动删除
kebab_example: aliyun ehpcinstant un-tag-resources --resource-type Job --resource-id job-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

Job
Executor
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。取值范围：

Job
Executor
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表。N 的取值范围为：1~50
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The list of tag keys. A maximum of 20 subkeys can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 标签键列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete all tags of the target resource. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is empty. Default value: False
parameters.help_zh: 是否删除目标资源的所有标签，仅TagKey.N为空时生效。默认 False
parameters.name: all
